reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: Code reading verified: protocol.rs:396-401 adds BlobsByRange to supported_protocols based only on fork_exists(ForkName::Deneb), with no check for current_epoch vs FULU_FORK_EPOCH + MIN_EPOCHS_FOR_BLOB_SIDECARS_REQUESTS (4096 epochs). Handler at rpc_methods.rs:992-1101 validates data_availability_boundary (pruning) but lacks epoch-based deprecation logic. Spec requirement confirmed from 01e file outputs/01e_PARTIAL_W2B3_1771748669.json line 770-786 (INV-028) and SG-011 subgraph: protocol must respond empty or reject after FULU_FORK_EPOCH + 4096 epochs. Attack path is exploitable: after deprecation deadline, attackers can force nodes to serve legacy blob sidecars indefinitely, creating resource contention with PeerDAS data column serving and bypassing the intended migration timeline. Severity calibrated to Medium per BUG_BOUNTY_SCOPE.json: single-client impact affects Lighthouse nodes only (deployment share <33%), but vulnerability is directly exploitable via P2P network (in-scope attack vector). Impact is resource exhaustion and protocol migration interference, not consensus failure or slashing.
reviewed_items.spec_reference: 01e PROP-6a4369e9-inv-028: 'blob_sidecars_by_range must be fully deprecated after FULU_FORK_EPOCH + MIN_EPOCHS' (assertion: current_epoch >= FULU_FORK_EPOCH + MIN_EPOCHS_FOR_BLOB_SIDECARS_REQUESTS => respond_empty_or_reject). SG-011 subgraph: fully deprecated state requires respond empty or reject.
